h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Dallas with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: My ticket says Irving, not Dallas. Does that matter?
faqs.a: Yes. You deal with Irving’s court, which has a 21-day deadline and needs a notarized affidavit. Every court is in the finder above.

faqs.q: Can I take the course online?
faqs.a: Yes. Once your court approves you, any TDLR-approved online course counts at every Dallas-area court.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
faqs.a: Usually 90 days after the court approves you. In Glenn Heights the clock starts when you pay.

faqs.q: Will this keep the ticket off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record. Paying the ticket doesn’t.

title: Dallas Ticket Dismissal: Deadlines & Fees for 25 Courts
